beats.say: Nine terrifying new monsters are invading your Roblox maze this Halloween.
The Hollow server wide horror event is officially live for a limited time.
A brand new monster will spawn inside the maze every single day for nine days.
You will face creatures from famous horror games like DOORS, Dandy's World and 99 Nights in the Forest.
A live finale event takes place on Saturday 31st October 2026.
The entire Hollow event ends on Monday 2nd November 2026. Will you survive the maze?

facts: The Hollow event is launching in Roblox on Thursday 22nd October 2026 at 10pm BST.
A new monster will appear in the maze each day for nine days.
The Hollow features creatures from famous horror games like 99 Nights in the Forest, Dandy's World and DOORS.
A live finale for The Hollow takes place on Saturday 31st October 2026.
The Hollow event ends in Roblox on Monday 2nd November 2026.
